assets.title: Global Flood Database
assets.summary: Historical flood event archive derived from MODIS, covering recorded flood extents and timing from 2000 to 2018.
assets.notes: Best for retrospective flood-event lookup rather than near-real-time monitoring.

assets.title: OPERA DSWx-S1
assets.summary: Dynamic Surface Water Extent from Sentinel-1 SAR, suitable for recent flood and surface-water mapping under cloudy conditions.
assets.notes: Strong choice for near-real-time flood mapping and all-weather monitoring.

assets.title: OPERA DSWx-HLS
assets.summary: Dynamic Surface Water Extent from Harmonized Landsat Sentinel imagery, useful when optical conditions are good.
assets.notes: Prefer this for clean optical scenes and visually interpretable water boundaries.

assets.title: JRC Global Surface Water
assets.summary: Long-term global surface-water statistics, including occurrence, seasonality, and transition metrics.
assets.notes: Use this for multi-year water persistence and long-term change patterns.

assets.title: JRC Monthly Water History
assets.summary: Monthly surface-water history time series for revisiting how water presence changes month by month.
assets.notes: Useful for monthly retrospective analysis rather than instantaneous event detection.

assets.title: JRC Monthly Water Recurrence
assets.summary: Monthly recurrence product describing how often water returns in each month across the historical record.
assets.notes: Best for understanding seasonality, recurrence, and water stability.

assets.title: JRC Yearly Water History
assets.summary: Annual surface-water history classes for comparing water extent and persistence across years.
assets.notes: A compact option when the question is framed at yearly resolution.

assets.title: GLCF Global Inland Water
assets.summary: Global inland-water product for quickly locating lakes, rivers, and reservoirs.
assets.notes: Useful as a broad reference layer for inland-water distribution.

assets.title: USGS WBD HUC04
assets.summary: US watershed boundary layer at the HUC04 regional basin level.
assets.notes: Use when the question is about basin boundaries or watershed context in the United States.

assets.title: USGS WBD HUC10
assets.summary: US watershed boundary layer at the HUC10 sub-basin level.
assets.notes: A better fit for medium-scale watershed-unit analysis in the United States.

assets.title: USGS WBD HUC12
assets.summary: US watershed boundary layer at the HUC12 subwatershed level.
assets.notes: Use this when you need fine-grained watershed boundaries in the United States.
